reuse.why: The change reuses sheet, budget-write, batching and undo helpers, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses the new shared category selector.

duplication.why: Hidden-category eligibility exists in both SQL and JavaScript, while income and fixed-group exclusion checks remain repeated across all six month-wide actions.

placement.why: Category selection and budget calculations stay in budget/actions.ts, with method registration and undo wrapping in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, focused tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: The helpers improve reuse, but getFillableCategories owns only part of eligibility, leaving maintainers to coordinate policy changes across several action bodies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth independently applies hidden-category and saved-template eligibility instead of using getFillableCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: getFillableCategories expresses hidden-category eligibility through SQL predicates, while copyPreviousMonth expresses the same policy through JavaScript guards.

abstraction_drift.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: getFillableCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and conditional hidden filtering; copyPreviousMonth bypasses that selector, and fixed-group exclusion remains distributed among callers.
